heard: NASA fixed a broken Mars drill using its robotic arm. Most people think a mechanical failure ends a deep space mission. A motor failure in December 2016 left Curiosity's drill stuck. The car-sized rover could no longer push drill bits into rock. Radio signals took 14 minutes to travel across deep space, so NASA engineers programmed a radical software workaround. Curiosity used its entire seven-foot arm like a human drill press. The rover successfully resumed rock drilling in May 2018. No physical repair crew ever landed on Mars.
